experiences.description: Sipping a lot of coffee and getting things done. Working on slashing CAC, scaling & engaging users for Moving Tech's portfolio of apps.
achievements: Managing growth for the entire app portfolio: Namma Yatri, Yatri Sathi, Odisha Yatri, Chennai One & Kerala Savaari
0-1 scaling of customer acquisition and rides for Bharat Taxi
Refreshing dashboards at odd hours out of curiosity & thrill
learnings: Multi-app growth at scale forces you to build playbooks fast and adapt faster
0-1 on a new product within an existing org is a completely different muscle from scaling
The best growth insights often come from obsessing over dashboards at 2am

experiences.description: Handled a sizeable performance marketing budget of ₹1.4 Cr/month and managed lead flow for a multi-city inside sales team of 150+ members.
achievements: Optimized campaigns across Google Search, Meta, PMAX, YouTube, Demand Gen, Taboola, and Bing
Scaled Meta Instant Forms campaigns by reducing cost per meeting and improving leads-to-meeting ratio
Implemented custom Unbounce landing page with dynamic keyword insertion & wrote script to fetch city names and pricing dynamically
Deployed Meta CLO CAPI and Website CAPI integrations, enabling 1.5x increase in leads at similar spend levels
Collaborated with creative team to conceptualize ad creatives and performance videos
Built critical marketing dashboards and trackers with the data team for data-driven decisions
Conducted regular audits of search terms, keywords and creatives, including n-gram analysis
Led lead generation for commercial offerings (PGs, schools, retail) and drove meetings for multiple eight-figure projects
Built and managed Zapier workflows for lead allocation and pincode mapping
Created marketing performance reports and presented actionable insights to leadership
learnings: Performance marketing at scale requires constant experimentation with audience segments, bidding strategies, and optimization goals
Automation (Zapier, scripts) is key to reducing manual work and scaling efficiently
Data-driven decisions beat gut feelings when managing large budgets

experiences.description: Working in a seed stage startup & being part of a 0-1 journey is truly exhilarating! Tried a bunch of things. Some worked, some didn't. But everything taught me something.
achievements: Conceptualized and authored compelling scripts for video ads promoting various courses, contributing to better conversion and 45% reduced CPL
Drove 30k+ user signups for free masterclasses via organic and performance channels
Researched and crafted content for Airtribe's Product Newsletter, reaching 15k+ subscribers with 25% open rate
Took charge of marketing analytics and dashboarding, ensuring data-driven decision-making for the team
Crafted quiz content aligned with masterclass sessions using effective prompting. Drove adoption through WhatsApp messages as reminders and engagement touchpoints
Created lead magnets: Curated PM Templates, PM Interview Questions, Growth Hacking Guide, Product Management Guide — drove 2000+ leads organically
Started a new IP for Airtribe's YouTube & scripted the first 10 episodes
learnings: 0-1 journeys teach you more than any playbook ever could
Data-driven decisions beat gut feelings at scale
Lead magnets work when they solve real problems
